method: Each clean detached lane ran its full focused suite before and after testing. Each production-only change was applied alone, inspected as a Git diff, restored, reapplied identically, and verified by an assertion inside the intended named test before restoration. SHA-256 and clean Git status verified after every run. Counts below are actual Node test reporter counts.

argv: --test-name-pattern=stored validation ignores renderer|validation rejects machine-local bearer
